notes: Probed https://ria.ru/robots.txt (200, permissive: only *-print.html, /search/, /id/, /cms/ etc. disallowed; page= params explicitly allowed via Allow:). No /sitemap.xml or /sitemap-index.xml (both 404), but robots names Sitemap: https://ria.ru/sitemap_article_index.xml, which lists per-month article sitemaps of the form https://ria.ru/sitemap_article.xml?date_start=YYYYMMDD&date_end=YYYYMMDD. KEY FINDING: the endpoint accepts an arbitrary range, so ONE request for date_start=20260925&date_end=20261025 (status 200, 4.1 MB) returned all 24,571 articles in the window. Each <loc> is https://ria.ru/YYYYMMDD/<slug>-<id>.html with a <lastmod> in +03:00. Listed date = the YYYYMMDD in the URL path, which is RIA's own publication date: lastmod date differs from path date for only 620/24571 entries and always LATER (edits), so path date is publish time, lastmod is edit time. Verified by re-fetching 4 sample articles (posolstvo-2126071521, edmonton-2121120245, aldonin-2120481775, putin-2126849985): all HTTP 200, JSON-LD datePublished date == listed date exactly, articleBody 7,676-9,000 chars. Output: 24,571 unique URLs, 31/31 days; check days 2026-09-30=956, 2026-10-10=625, 2026-10-20=860. Script runs in ~56s (1 sitemap request through polite_fetch; monthly-index fallback path included for safety but not needed). Total requests: ~6 (robots, two 404 sitemap probes, index, range sitemap, 4 samples).
